notice: Ground truth for a synthetic case. The evidence describes a fictional convenience-store chain and two fictional vendors. No real Walmart data is used and no access to any Walmart system is claimed.
authoring_limitation: Authored by the same person who wrote the corpus. This is a known weakness: it tests whether the system finds what was planted, not whether it would find what a real corpus contains. Recorded in docs/04-evaluation.md rather than hidden.
question: Which intervention should the team prioritise to reduce markdown losses on perishables?
desired_outcome: Reduce fresh markdown losses without moving the loss into waste, while holding on-shelf availability at or above the 93% floor and adding no hours to the store labour model.

scoring_rules.recall_denominator: Only entries with must_detect true count toward recall. GT-M5 is must_detect false: it is a real gap, but finding it is credit rather than a requirement.
scoring_rules.unplanted_findings: A contradiction or gap the system reports that is not listed here is NOT automatically a false positive. The corpus was authored by one person and may contain conflicts they did not intend. Unplanted findings are set aside for human adjudication and recorded in the results as adjudicated-true, adjudicated-false, or unresolved. Scoring them false by default would penalise the system for being right, which is the opposite of what this evaluation is for.
scoring_rules.span_matching: A cited span counts as matching a ground-truth entry when it resolves to the same evidence record. Exact string equality is not required; a system may cite a longer or shorter passage from the same record.
scoring_rules.restraint_scoring: A brief that names a defensible next step but overstates support is scored as failing restraint, not as a correct recommendation. Naming the right option is necessary but not sufficient.
scoring_rules.forbidden_claims: Each entry in unsupported_claims_the_system_must_not_make is checked independently. Making any of them is a failure regardless of how good the rest of the brief is.

evidence_hazards.span: Markdown losses in prepared salads and cut fruit fell 22% against the preceding quarter, July to September 2025.
evidence_hazards.description: The Halcyon pilot ran October to December and is compared against the immediately preceding July to September, in prepared salads and cut fruit. category_review.md states that markdown in exactly this category peaks in July to September and falls by roughly a quarter to a third in October to December every year, and markdown_metrics.csv shows Larkfield's own prepared salad rate falling from 11.8% to 8.4% between those two quarters of 2025 — about 29% — with no intervention. The claimed 22% improvement is smaller than the seasonal movement it is measured across. Neither document mentions the other, and neither points out the confound.
evidence_hazards.why_it_matters: This is the difference between the two vendor claims. Verdant's figure is unmethodical; Halcyon's looks methodical — it names a period, a category and a comparison — and is worse, because the comparison window is chosen so that the season does the work. A brief that discounts Verdant for having no method but accepts Halcyon for having one has been caught by the shape of the evidence rather than its content.

evidence_hazards.hazard: proxy metric standing in for the thing that matters
evidence_hazards.span: Collections are made at close and the diverted volume is recorded as waste, not as markdown.
evidence_hazards.description: The question asks about markdown loss; the objective is total fresh loss. The two lines are separate accounts over the same stock, and moving stock between them changes the markdown rate without changing the loss. The redistribution partnership already does this in 68 stores, and late markdown execution raises both lines together rather than trading one for the other.
evidence_hazards.why_it_matters: An option can win on the stated metric while doing nothing for the goal. This is what tempts GT-U7.

evidence_hazards.span: Figures are aggregated from customers who elected to share results with us.
evidence_hazards.description: Verdant's 34% is an average over an unstated number of customers who chose to report. Customers whose deployments went badly are absent by construction, and no measurement period or baseline is given.
evidence_hazards.why_it_matters: The figure has no denominator and no comparison group. It is a marketing average, not an effect size, and it tempts GT-U1.

credible.name: Buy Verdant Pricing Cloud
credible.note: Requires electronic shelf labels and a real-time till price feed, neither of which exists at scale. The only evidence is a self-selected vendor average with no method.

credible.name: Buy Halcyon Shelf Intelligence
credible.note: Needs no hardware, which makes it the more feasible purchase, but it consumes an item-level shelf-life feed that does not exist, and its only result is a seasonally confounded quarter-on-quarter comparison.

credible.name: Build store-level markdown recommendations in-house
credible.note: The one-quarter estimate is a stakeholder opinion contradicted by the platform's depot-level scope and absent expiry data. Would require building the missing data before building the model.

credible.name: Partner with Ashcombe Foods on further shelf-life extension and order profile
credible.note: The April 2026 extension from three days to four is documented, but prepared salad markdown still rose year on year afterwards, so the mechanism is plausible and the effect unmeasured.

credible.name: Extend the food redistribution partnership beyond the 68 neighbourhood stores
credible.note: Changes the disposition of unsold stock rather than the loss. Diverted volume is booked as waste, so this would move the markdown rate without moving total fresh loss.

credible.name: Fix markdown execution in the 121 lowest-compliance stores
credible.note: The largest measured variation in the corpus is execution, not tooling. Needs no vendor, no capital and no new data, but the cause of the split is unknown.

credible.name: Reinstate the two-stage markdown round with control stores
credible.note: Countermanded by D-2025-11 on labour grounds and constrained by the FY25 hours cap. Its only supporting result could not be attributed.

recommendation_restraint.reason: No option has strong support. The two vendor figures carry no usable method between them — one is a self-selected average with no baseline, the other a quarter-on-quarter comparison across the steepest seasonal decline in the category. The only internal trial had twelve stores, no control group and two confounds inside its own window. The best-evidenced observation in the corpus is not about tooling at all: markdown execution varies from below 40% to above 90% between stores, and nothing explains why. A brief claiming strong support for any option is overconfident on this evidence.
defensible_next_steps: Work the execution split first: identify what separates the 121 stores below 40% compliance from the 137 above 90%, since no tool will run in stores that do not run the round.
Instrument markdown-to-sale conversion and report markdown, waste and total fresh loss together, so any later option can be measured against the goal rather than the proxy.
Ask both vendors for a like-for-like result — same quarter prior year, or non-deployed stores in the same period — and treat neither current figure as an effect size.

Sequence any dynamic pricing purchase behind the Q1 2027 EPOS intra-day pilot and the shelf-label refresh, and behind the colleague consultation and data protection assessment that both run for at least six weeks.

must_not_recommend_without_conditions.why: Intra-day price changes are impossible on the nightly till price file, shelf and till prices must match with only 43 stores carrying electronic shelf labels, no item-level shelf-life feed exists, neither vendor has quoted a price, and colleague consultation plus the data protection assessment take at least six weeks each.
The only feasibility estimate is a stakeholder opinion, and it is contradicted by the forecasting platform's depot-level scope and its lack of any shelf-life data. No effort estimate exists.
Adding a markdown round breaches the FY25 colleague hours cap and reverses D-2025-11, which was taken on exactly those labour grounds.

restraint_signals_that_must_appear: The recommendation must state that neither vendor figure is a measured effect, and must say why for each separately rather than dismissing them as one.
The recommendation must state that the Halcyon comparison is quarter-on-quarter across a documented seasonal decline in the same category.
The recommendation must not present the two-stage markdown trial as a measured result.
The recommendation must distinguish markdown loss from total fresh loss and note that no option has been measured against the latter.
The recommendation must not present executive preference or the in-house one-quarter estimate as evidence.
